claims.text: The numerical model can be modified to analyze wave-induced vertical mixing processes in offshore conditions.
The derived modelling framework may be adapted for open-ocean conditions, indicating applicability beyond just nearshore environments.
The study aims to improve models applicable to ocean waves of random nature, which includes both nearshore and offshore dynamics.
